limitations: Independent model/agent annotations are fallible, not human ground truth or mathematical proof of entailment.
The small synthetic public corpus was frozen before these calls; it is not a private blind benchmark or a statistical generalization claim.
No inference, authentication, embedding, private key/import/settings read or database mutation was performed by the reviewer.
All 38 planned entries are retained. No failed or skipped observations occurred; correct question counts are not confused with context correctness.
Eight no_ltm responses safely lack known historical facts; this is an intentional baseline, not an answer hallucination.
f12 retrieval honestly provides address/hours but lacks code because only two chunks were selected once. This does not prove poor embedding or failure of a future multi-step tool-search agent.
Actual effects, broad task completion, billing invoice and physical host overhead remain separate from factual answer quality.
SQL/original-event/source/resource/persistence correlation is documented separately in the independent fresh-results report; old strict and retrospective v2 results are preserved.
